authorized_pr: PR #80 amendment A1+A2 (mandatory 7-prop proof coverage + manifest integrity)
rationale: A1: prove mode now requires the full frozen target-prop list and emits exactly one explicit status per prop (PASS/FAIL/INSUFFICIENT/MISSING_CANDIDATE/MISSING_PROOF_ROWS/CONTAMINATED); missing props are never dropped and Holm is applied over the fixed 14-claim family with missing claims treated as non-passing. A2: prove mode performs fail-closed verification of the candidate manifest (per-prop candidate_id/probability_track/model_hash/feature_schema_hash/calibration_policy_hash/calibrator_hash/training_date_max/selection_date_max/proof_date_min) and split manifest (proof dates, input_dataset_hash, quote/settlement policy hashes, creation timestamp, previous_access_count==0) before touching proof rows, marking per-prop chronology overlap CONTAMINATED. Strengthens the bar only.
